name: Imouto to Yaritai Koto no Subete "Gokun...... Nee, Nandemo Suru kara, Kore, Motto Choudai, Onii-chan"
original_name: 妹とヤリたいことのすべて「ごくん……ねぇ、なんでもするから、これ、もっとちょうだい、お兄ちゃん」
source:
Tatsuma and his three younger sisters; Kokoro, Hinami and Shizuku lost their parents and live together. Tatsuma never leaves his room however. He refuses to do household chores and refuses to work. Finally having enough of a freeloading brother the sisters kick him out. They can do without him. However the next month the money from their inheritance stops being deposited in the bank. Angry that he would steal money from them the oldest sister confronts him. "What have you done with our parents money!"
"We spent it a long time ago," he explains. "I'm the one who's been putting money in the bank every month." It turns out he had a programming job on his computer he did every day to support his sisters but he stopped when they threw him out. "Want money?" he asks. "Give me a blowjob." He treats his second oldest and youngest sister the same while keeping it a secret from the others as his sexual demands of them continues to grow.

All according to plan.
translation:
辰磨和三个妹妹心、雏美与雫失去父母后共同生活。然而辰磨从不离开房间，拒绝做家务，也拒绝工作。妹妹们终于受够了这个吃闲饭的哥哥，把他赶出了家门。她们本以为没有他也能生活，可下个月，继承父母遗产的钱却不再汇入银行。大妹妹以为哥哥偷走了钱，愤怒地质问他：“你把父母的钱弄到哪里去了！”

“我们很久以前就花光了。”辰磨解释道，“每个月往银行里存钱的人一直是我。”原来，他每天用电脑做编程工作来供养妹妹们，只是在被赶出家门后停止了工作。

“想要钱吗？”他问道。

“那就给我口交。”

他对二妹和小妹也做了同样的事，同时对其他妹妹保密；而他对她们提出的性要求还在不断增加。

一切都按照计划进行。
